name: The Fathomless
description: A warlock whose patron is an ancient, elemental entity of the deep ocean.

expanded_spell_list._notes: 4th-level Summon Elemental is flavored as water-only for this patron (real text: 'you can only summon a Water elemental'), and 5th-level Bigby's Hand is flavored as a tentacle rather than a hand — both real spell names kept as-is so they resolve against the spell catalog; the reflavor is cosmetic, not a mechanical change.
